recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not add RelatedPerson to Observation.subject for this issue; use Observation.focus when the observation is stored against one subject of record but focused on a related person or other associated resource. Any optional cleanup of deprecated focusCode extension wording belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack, not this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-13425 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3. It asked how to document a related person's health literacy or care skill, such as whether a mother is trained to change her child's tracheostomy tube, when Observation.subject did not support RelatedPerson; the final resolution chose focal-subject/focus with the child as subject and mother as focal target.
initial_application: Historical source shows 75c4cced61 added focal-subject.reference with Reference(Patient, Person, RelatedPerson, Group, Device), a RelatedPerson note, and #13425 tagging; d06b52856c retained the #13425 trail while separating code and reference focus modeling; 5c093b94a9 renamed Observation.focalSubject to Observation.focus.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Observation.subject remains the record subject and does not target RelatedPerson, while Observation.focus is Reference(Resource) for the actual focus when it differs from the subject of record. Later FHIR-14443/FHIR-14863 and Zulip discussion support using focus instead of broadening subject, FHIR-43357 later reinforces that modeling, and the old focusCode extension is now deprecated/retired in the FHIR Extension Pack.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the current core build already conveys the requested subject/focus pattern and has the requested tracheostomy-care example.
